name: Consumption: Food and Choices

categories.label: Score track VP before final scoring
categories.labelVi: VP trên track (trước tính điểm cuối)
categories.hint: VP from completed recipes and activities scored during play.

categories.label: Food groups with 0 tokens
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on each empty food group (e.g. Alcohol 5).

categories.label: Food groups on yellow/green
categories.labelVi: Nhóm thực phẩm ở ô vàng/xanh
categories.hint: Per group, VP of the furthest token's space (e.g. Grains 5). Enter total.

categories.label: Food groups on red (penalty)
categories.labelVi: Nhóm thực phẩm ở ô đỏ (phạt)
categories.hint: Enter total as a negative number (e.g. Seafood -3).

categories.label: Incomplete recipe/activity cards (penalty)
categories.hint: Enter the sum of VP printed on incomplete cards as a negative number.

categories.label: End-game VP on completed recipes
categories.labelVi: VP cuối game của công thức
categories.hint: Completed recipe cards with a pink ability that give end-game VP.

categories.label: Activity sets completed
categories.hint: Number of sets of each size from unique icons: 3=5, 4=7, 5=10, 6=14, 7=19, 8=25 VP. A card belongs to one set only.

formula.expr: sets3 * 5 + sets4 * 7 + sets5 * 10 + sets6 * 14 + sets7 * 19 + sets8 * 25

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker stated in the available rules text; treat as shared victory.

endCondition.description: Game ends after round 6, then end-game scoring.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Food group values (Alcohol 5, Seafood -3, Grains 5) are examples from the rules; real values are printed on each diet board, so group totals are scorer inputs. Solo uses the same scoring ranked against a personal goals chart; Cleanse diet board and 2-player variants not modelled. Official PDF (BGG file 259188) could not be downloaded (Cloudflare block); text taken from RulesPal's reproduction, so needsReview=true.
